g.text: M7: streamwise temporal Welch spectra versus full-band longitudinal measurements
Limited inlet band with SVV; scope-qualified descriptive comparison. No full-band fidelity or 2% accuracy verdict.
Periodic Hann Welch; full-record own-probe centering; F11 = Ubar Sf/(2 pi). Radial inlet taper is shaded. Low k1 does not imply a shell-band-matched target.
